title: billing.debit
description: Payload for the billing.debit comm Function — service-to-service wallet debit (wrapper over stapel_billing.services.debit). idempotency_key is REQUIRED: comm delivery is at-least-once and a retry with the same key returns the original transaction instead of debiting twice. Returns {"ok": bool, "balance": int|null, "reason": str|null, "transaction_id"?: str}. type values mirror stapel_billing.models.TransactionType.
